headlines.title: Workday (WDAY) Deepens Its AI Push Through Two New Partnerships
headlines.summary: Workday (NasdaqGS:WDAY) has partnered with The Josh Bersin Company to integrate its Galileo AI-based HR advisory agent into Workday tools. The firm also announced a collaboration with Zuora to connect Workday finance applications with Zuora's AI and usage-based pricing capabilities. Both partnerships aim to expand Workday's AI-driven workforce planning and billing features for large enterprises.

headlines.title: Workday and The Josh Bersin Company Bring Galileo Agent to Workday Customers in Sana, Giving HR Leaders Instant Access to Trusted Expertise
headlines.summary: Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ: WDAY), the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, and The Josh Bersin Company, today announced they will make Galileo, The Josh Bersin Company's AI-powered HR research and advisory agent, available to Workday customers in Sana.

headlines.title: Workday and Zuora Expand Partnership to Help Companies Launch AI and Usage-Based Pricing Without Sacrificing Accuracy or Financial Control
headlines.summary: Workday, Inc. (NASDAQ: WDAY), the trusted agentic platform for HR, finance, and IT, and Zuora Inc., the leading monetization platform and system of record for quote-to-cash, today announced an expanded partnership to help companies launch new pricing models, such as AI and usage-based pricing, faster and without losing accuracy or control of their financial records.

headlines.title: Avalara Launches 1099 E-File For Workday, a Workday Design Approved Integration
headlines.summary: Avalara, Inc., the agentic AI leader in global tax and compliance, today announced it has launched Avalara 1099 E-File For Workday, a new application through the Built on Workday Partner program. The integration provides customers with native, embedded 1099 e-filing and end-to-end filing lifecycle visibility directly within Workday Financial Management, helping remove the manual exports and external portal hops that previously added risk and work during filing season.

headlines.title: Workday (WDAY) Increases Yet Falls Behind Market: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, Workday (WDAY) stood at $191.16, denoting a +1.2% move from the preceding trading day.

description: Workday, Inc. provides enterprise cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company offers a suite of financial management applications to maintain accounting information; manage financial processes, such as payables and receivables; identify real-time financial, operational, and management insights; perform financial consolidation; reduce time-to-close; promote internal control and auditability; and achieve consistency across finance operations. It also provides spend management solutions that help organizations to streamline supplier selection and contract management, build and execute sourcing events, such as requests for proposals, and manage indirect spend; expense management solutions to submit and approve expenses; and a suite of human capital management applications that enables HR teams to hire, onboard, pay, develop, reskill, and provide employee experiences. In addition, the company offers planning applications. Further, it provides supply chain and inventory solutions to healthcare organizations; solutions to manage the end-to-end student and faculty lifecycle; Workday Extend for customers and their developers to build custom applications. The company serves the professional and business services, financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, media, education, government, technology, media, retail, and hospitality industries. It sells its solutions through its direct sales organization. The company was formerly known as North Tahoe Power Tools, Inc. and changed its name to Workday, Inc. in July 2005. Workday, Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Pleasanton, California.
